name: C. Back gate servo 2 a spline off
description: The back gate's second servo went onto its spline a tooth off. Its positions are nowhere near 1 - servo 1's, so copying servo 1 mirrored would make the two fight. Program 4 sets servo 2 on its own, by ear: step it until the buzz stops.

faults.text: Back gate servo 2 sits a spline tooth off: its positions are its own.
faults.caughtBy: 4 Servo Positions, steps 4 and 6 (back gate servo 2): match it to servo 1 until neither buzzes
